tools.name: element
tools.title: Element
tools.summary: Element properties, electron configuration, isotopes; or the periodic table

query.description: Symbol, English name, or atomic number (e.g. Fe, iron, 26). Leave empty for the full periodic table.
query.label: Element
query.title: Query

tools.name: units
tools.title: Units
tools.summary: Chemistry unit conversions: energy, cm⁻¹/nm/K, dipole, polarizability, rate constants, pressure, charge

query.description: A value and unit, optionally with a target unit (e.g. 1 eV to kcal/mol, 300 nm, 760 Torr to bar). A group name (e.g. pressure) lists its units; leave empty to list all units.
query.label: Conversion
query.title: Query

temperature.description: Temperature for the RT and kT values shown with energies: a number in K, or with a unit (25 C, 77 F).
temperature.label: Temperature (for RT, kT)
temperature.title: Temperature

show_all.description: Also show less common units of each group.
show_all.label: Show all units
show_all.title: Show All

tools.name: xyz
tools.title: XYZ viewer
tools.summary: Paste XYZ coordinates: formula, molecular weight, closest atoms, and a 3D view

text.description: XYZ coordinates: standard XYZ (one or more frames), or just 'element x y z' lines. In the terminal: a file path, or pipe the text in.
text.label: XYZ coordinates
text.title: Text

frame.description: Frame to show first (1 = first). Default: 1.
frame.title: Frame

style.description: How atoms and bonds are drawn.
style.title: Style

tools.name: stereo
tools.title: Stereoisomers
tools.summary: All stereoisomers of a SMILES: R/S and E/Z labels, relations, 2D and 3D

smiles.description: SMILES of the molecule, e.g. CC(Br)C(Br)C. Stereo marks (@, /, \) already in the SMILES are kept unless --enumerate-all is given. Simple condensed formulas such as CH3-CH(OH)-CH3 are also accepted.
smiles.label: SMILES
smiles.title: Smiles

max_isomers.description: Largest number of stereoisomers to make. More takes longer.
max_isomers.label: Max isomers
max_isomers.title: Max Isomers

enumerate_all.description: Also enumerate the stereo centers already given in the SMILES.
enumerate_all.label: Enumerate specified centers too
enumerate_all.title: Enumerate All
